notes.title: Strategy (Character)
notes.content:
Most people are probably attracted by the art style, which is a strong point of the game. The character illustrations are beautiful, and the game provides a lot of resources in the early stages. Some say this is just an AI-generated art game, but similar games will become more common in the future. Take it or leave it.
T0 Damage Heroes:
SSS Pomona
SSS Zephyr
SSR Tang Su (requires purchase)
These are the main damage heroes in the current version. Since the late game involves 10v10 scenarios or Boss fights, Pomona excels at controlling enemy HP and clearing the field, while Zephyr specializes in high single-target damage.
T0 Support Heroes:
SR Lotus
SSS Shizuka
SSS Aurelia
SSS Yukine
SSS Drake
SSR Ming Ju
SSR Cixia
The ranking is in order of cost-effectiveness and priority.
Early Game Relics:
Focus on golden speed relics, purple speed relics, and exclusive relics for damage heroes. Other relics are less critical early on; use whatever you have.
Summoning Heroes:
Wait for the UP event pool updates. Prioritize obtaining the main damage heroes (need to draw them 8 times to max out), then fill in the support heroes according to the sequence listed above.
Resource Management:
Unlike other games, resources such as Breakthrough Stone, summon tokens, and Hero EXP are limited early on. It's difficult to evenly upgrade your whole team, and doing so won't maximize your attack efficiency. Therefore, focus on upgrading your T0 damage heroes and the primary support hero, Lotus. Completing the main storyline grants red summon tokens as rewards, and early achievements provide plenty of red diamonds. Summoning heroes is fun and not too stressful early on.
If you're just playing casually, you can stop reading here. If you plan to play for a long time, keep reading.
Resource Allocation:
This game is essentially a resource allocation game. The main value systems include honor points, Union points, friendship points, production points, gold, red diamonds, colored diamonds, Star Stone, and energy. Colored diamonds can only be obtained through purchases. Determining what resources to exchange for what items requires comparing the rarity and demand and the ways which you can get them. Here are some simple examples, with the rest left for you to explore:
Use honor points to exchange for gems until they reach level 15.
Save Star Stone for exchanging UR fragments, which becomes available when your player level (not hero level) reaches a certain lv. Unlocking UR heroes can significantly enhance some skills.
Save energy for crafting enchant scrolls and enhance scrolls in the late game; don't use it recklessly.
Upgrade equipment within your means. The basic stat differences are significant, but the energy demand is also high. Allocating energy wisely helps you progress the main storyline more efficiently.
Overall, this game currently has minimal PvP elements and focuses on character development. It is a casual card game that doesn't require much daily time. Once your team is strong enough, it becomes a strategy card game where you need to arrange hero deployment order, manage de-buff heroes, and adjust hero speed and positioning based on the opponent's attack order and your own team's expected casualties. This also requires a substantial investment to support. If you prefer a slower pace, almost all in-game resources can be obtained for free over time.
Subscriptions and Packages:
All subscriptions offer good value. Renew them when they expire. Prioritize gem packages, followed by UR packages. Daily energy packages are very beneficial if you invest in them consistently.
Thank you for reading this guide. I hope it helps you in your journey. Enjoy your waifus!!!

notes.title: Strategy (Character)
notes.content:
Chapter 1 SSR hero transition at the beginning and SSS card extraction suggestions

As an idle card game, the development of this game is very long. It takes a long time to graduate a character. Therefore, in the early stage, only one output character is selected to act as the main C. It can be easily passed with the human rights Kallen and several other pendants. Try to earn red tickets. (Don’t level up, don’t level up, don’t level up. Say the important things three times. In the early stage of the game, we only level up Main C and Lian. Remember!)

Before introducing the transitional characters that can be used in SSR, I will first introduce the two main protagonists of this game (hereinafter referred to as the Phantom God).
Wavemon: The strongest in PVP, he can push the map easily in the early stage, he can also solve ordinary bosses, and it is not easy to overturn in the corridor.
Hayate: The strongest in PVE. He is a dog-betting character. It takes a long time to push the map, but he can bet on critical hits and jump over the map. He can handle all single bosses with ease. He is a must-have for fighting dragons. Even with high combat power in the corridor, it is easy to overturn. (Half wind is my destiny, I will introduce concave pictures and dragon fighting methods later)


Since the rotation mechanism of the SSS character up pool is to randomly rotate all SSS (without repetition), it will be regarded as one round, which means that the same hero will appear at the end of one round and the beginning of the new round, every Monday and Thursday. If the rotation is performed at 8 o'clock in the morning, two situations may occur:
1. The week you enter the pit happens to be the week when the Phantom God is up. In this case, I recommend the initial brushing. Just brush out a 1-star Phantom God (the 1 drawn out in this game is only 0 stars and has only 1 active skill, so it is 1 star. To draw 2, there are 2 active skills). Then you can push the picture, take the red ticket and continue to draw the pool. If you are not satisfied with the draw this round, it is okay, just save the ticket and wait for the next round.
2. The week you entered the trap is not during the Fantasy God up week. It is not recommended for Kryptonians to just force the Magic God out of the ordinary pool. The income is very low. You can use SSR to make the transition first, save red tickets, and wait for the Fantasy God up pool to draw a wave. Fully broken, this waiting period can be as short as a few days or as long as 2 months (in the case of extremely bad luck), manpower is uncontrollable, and this stage is very discouraging for newcomers. It is recommended that players calm down, this is a game that hangs up to collect food. , Farming for a long time, we should achieve great achievements. (Some big guys in the group also played the initial opening, and got 4,500 red diamonds for ten consecutive bets. It took a long time to play, but it will be very comfortable to play the Beaumont opening, and there is less waiting time. Different people have different opinions)

Let me introduce to you the SSR role that can act as the main c during the transition period:
Tang Su: As the only character that can only be obtained with krypton gold, the strength is higher than that of most SSS, but the price/performance ratio is low, and you can’t get it for 0 krypton. We recommend buying one to open the illustration book, and the local tyrants can get it.
The following are in no particular order, whichever star is higher will be regarded as c:
Hongyan Angel, Rhea, Avania, Scarlett, Tephis

Next, I would like to recommend SSS support and her SSR sub-substitute:
Lian: Although she is an SR, she is an irreplaceable human rights card in this game. Without her, you wouldn’t even be qualified for the concave picture.
Shizuka: T0 auxiliary, extra attack and defense with milk, no lower position
Yukiyin: Increases damage (in this game, increases damage > increases attack), no lower position
Drex: Commonly known as Nuoshou by old players, he sucks blood, restrains monsters that can counter damage, and has no subordinates.
Nightingale: Bleeding monsters increase the damage they receive, lower rank: Rhea (the buff with the same name in this game does not stack, so you can kidnap one with the same buff)
Ling'er: Add defense break, lower position: Scarlett, Tephis
Aurora: Add attack, lower position: Mingju
Meryl: Acceleration, same position: Bud, lower position: Shinaga (the application of speed will be explained in the concave drawing teaching)
Xin: Adds critical hits and critical damage, lower ranks: Tang Su, Cixia (the biggest novice misunderstanding is that Xin cannot be paired with Gale, because it has the same buff, and Gale's own skill 1 adds buff, so Xin's best main C is Bomon)

notes.title: Getting Started Guide
notes.content:
A gift from the Adventurer's Guild (less detours in making equipment in the early stage, only need to make equipment for C)
Level 0, a set of blueprints (blacksmith)
Level 20, a set of green equipment (blacksmith)
Level 40, a set of green equipment (blacksmith)
Level 60, a set of blue equipment (blacksmith)
Level 80, a blue suit (tailor)
Level 100, a blue suit (tailor)
(Tip: No additional equipment is required in the early stage, just upgrade)

1. Character strength teaming and echelon (record ssr, sss, partial SR, human rights card)
             (Same star rating) SSS＞SSR＞SR
  In the early stage, you only need to increase the output, which is about level 160.
